Pick your city below and we'll confirm same-day availability.

products.heading: Core chairs & tables — rent by the piece or the full set

standardChair.name: Standard Chair
standardChair.tagline: The workhorse plastic chair every kenduri needs.
standardChair.blurb: Stackable, lightweight standard chair rental for kenduri, tahlil and backyard majlis. Plain at RM3.60 or with fabric cover at RM9.60 — we deliver by the hundred, same day, across Malaysia.

banquetChair.name: Banquet Chair
banquetChair.tagline: Padded cushion, steel frame — hotel-grade comfort.
banquetChair.blurb: Banquet chair rental for wedding receptions, dinner majlis and corporate dinners. Cushioned seat, cleaned before every delivery. Plain at RM14.40, with ribbon cover at RM21.60.

chiavariChair.name: Chiavari Chair
chiavariChair.tagline: The elegant wedding chair you see on Instagram.
chiavariChair.blurb: Solid Chiavari chair rental at RM21.60 or the transparent acrylic Chiavari at RM28.80 — perfect for pelamin photos, bridal tables and luxe engagement majlis. Available nationwide with same-day delivery.

longTable.name: Long Table / Buffet 6ft
longTable.tagline: The 6-foot workhorse for buffet lines and prep.
longTable.blurb: Long table rental in standard 6ft size. Without cloth at RM72.00, with pleated skirting and cloth at RM86.40. Pair it with our catering gear for a full buffet setup.

roundTable.name: Round Table (10-seater)
roundTable.tagline: Seats 10 guests comfortably — the kenduri standard.
roundTable.blurb: Round table rental that seats 10 guests — the go-to for Malay wedding receptions and Chinese banquet dinners. Plain at RM72.00, with cloth and overlay at RM86.40. Delivered stacked and ready.

cocktailTable.name: Cocktail Table
cocktailTable.tagline: High-top standing table for mingling and welcome drinks.
cocktailTable.blurb: Cocktail table rental at RM86.40 including white spandex cover — perfect for reception foyers, corporate networking, and welcome areas. Delivered same day in KL, Selangor and Johor.

additional.heading: Everything else your kenduri needs under one roof

couch.name: Couch Chair
couch.blurb: Vintage-style sofa seating for the pelamin, photo corner and VIP area. Upholstered in cream or gold.

tent.name: Tent / Canopy
tent.blurb: Standard 20ft × 20ft and 20ft × 40ft canopy rental for backyard kenduri. Waterproof top, steel frame, includes setup.

transparentCanopy.name: Transparent Canopy
transparentCanopy.blurb: Clear PVC transparent canopy rental for evening majlis with a view. Wind-rated, leak-proof.

airCooler.name: Air Cooler
airCooler.blurb: Industrial air cooler rental that actually cools open kenduri tents. Each unit covers ~40 m².

fan.name: Commercial Fan
fan.blurb: Heavy-duty commercial fan rental for canopy events. Quiet, powerful, comfortable through the longest doa.

pa.name: PA System
pa.blurb: Full PA system rental with microphone, mixer and 2 speakers — ideal for MC, nasyid and akad nikah.

catering.name: Catering Equipment
catering.blurb: Chafing dishes, soup warmers, water dispensers and buffet trays by the set.

popcorn.name: Popcorn Machine
popcorn.blurb: Red retro popcorn machine rental for birthdays and kids' corners.

cottonCandy.name: Cotton Candy Machine
cottonCandy.blurb: Pink or blue cotton candy machine rental — an instant crowd-pleaser.

howItWorks.heading: Book your rental in 3 steps
howItWorks.step1Body: Tell us the event date, venue address, guest count and any add-ons. We confirm availability in minutes.
howItWorks.step2Body: We send a written quote with total and delivery window. Lock in your booking with a small refundable deposit.
howItWorks.step3Title: We deliver, set up & pick up
howItWorks.step3Body: Our crew arrives on the agreed time, unloads, stacks, and returns after the majlis to collect. You don't lift a single chair.

reviews.heading: From real Google reviews
reviews.r1Body: Booked 200 banquet chairs and 20 round tables for my sister's nikah last weekend. Lorry came at 8am sharp, boys stacked everything neatly, and pickup was just as smooth. Will use Kak Kenduri again for sure.
reviews.r2Body: Needed a last-minute chiavari chair setup for a corporate dinner in PJ and they actually delivered same day. The transparent chiavari chairs looked amazing on camera. Pricing was clear upfront.
reviews.r3Body: From chairs to canopy, everything from Kak Kenduri for our kenduri rumah in JB. Easy to deal with on WhatsApp, no forms. Very reasonable pricing. Highly recommended.
